angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 382,635 km at 99.42 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.0582 +/- 0.0095 mas (same row, RUWE 1.03): 99.42 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.55 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Fukui et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1749 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..167F/abstract): 382,635 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.58 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Fukui et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1749 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..167F/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3985 +/- 55 K from Fukui et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1749 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..167F/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Fukui et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1749 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..167F/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1749.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.721, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1749 (pscomppars): spectral type M0 V, from Fukui et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..167F/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-1749: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1749 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.26 dex, from Fukui et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..167F/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1749 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.15649, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1749 (pscomppars): age 0.8 Gyr, from Fukui et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..167F/abstract)
